cds.text: Recognise, describe and create additive patterns that increase or decrease by a constant amount, and identify missing elements
Explain addition and subtraction as inverse operations; use this to partition numbers and find unknowns in number sentences
Find unknown values in addition and subtraction equations, using properties of numbers and operations
Demonstrate proficiency with addition facts to 20; extend them to develop related subtraction facts
Extend addition and subtraction facts to 20 to build efficient mental strategies for larger numbers without a calculator
Demonstrate proficiency with multiplication facts up to 10 x 10 and related division facts; extend to efficient mental strategies without a calculator
Demonstrate proficiency with multiplication facts for twos; extend to related division facts using doubling and halving
Demonstrate proficiency with multiplication facts for 3, 4, 5 and 10; extend to related division facts
